name: Feast Of Sabbatical Year The
overview: The Feast of the Sabbatical Year, observed every seventh year, calls for a complete cessation of agricultural labor, trusting in God's provision as He promises a blessing in the sixth year to sustain the people through the seventh and eighth years (Leviticus 25:20-22). This year also includes the release of debts among Hebrew neighbors, emphasizing mercy and community responsibility, while allowing repayment from foreigners (Deuteronomy 15:1-3). These instructions highlight God's care for His people, encouraging reliance on His faithfulness and the practice of generosity within the covenant community.
